summary: Iteration 7 end-to-end verified. Backend: 20/20 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py pass (~11s + STAC calls). Covers (a) GET /api/ais/density?hours=2160&zoom=6 shape {cells,max,resolution_deg} with lat/lon/count/vessels/w; hours>8760 -> 422; bbox=w,s,e,n filters cells; bad bbox -> 400; two identical calls return identical bodies (60s cache). (b) Scene watches: list any-role 200; analyst POST 403; supervisor POST invalid bbox 400; unknown collection 400; supervisor full flow create->patch(active:false)->run?sync=true (job.status='succeeded', result.watches[0].searched present)->delete 200 ok:true; cron /api/cron/scene-watch no-auth 401, wrong token 401, correct Bearer + X-Webhook-Id -> 202 {ok:true,run_id,job_id}, dup X-Webhook-Id -> 202 {duplicate:true}. WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env. (c) Detector on scene w/ metadata.preview_href: POST /api/scenes/{id}/detect-dark-spots -> 201 {detector:'darkspot-otsu-0.1.0-experimental', experimental:true, spots, cases[]}; case doc has source='dark_spot_detector', quality_flags contains 'experimental_detector', detection_confidence<=0.55; /api/cases/{id}/attachments has kind=sar_scene, content_type=image/webp thumbnail. Overlay endpoint returns {has_quicklook:true, bounds=[[s,w],[n,e]], bbox}. Quicklook returns image/* >1000 bytes in ~2-5s (cached). (d) /api/cases/{id}/before-after?days=20 for SPL-20260610-001 returns before/after/bbox/spill_geometry. (e) /api/spill-events?limit=5 returns {total,events,sources} with thumb + scene_provider_id per row; min_conf/status filters work. Regression: all 3 role logins, GET /api/cases, GET /api/zone-rules, evidence PDF for a dark-spot case all 200. Frontend (Playwright on public URL): analyst login OK. Events page: events-count '14 of 14 events', 14 virtualized event-card-* rendered, events-min-conf update reflects in URL query (?min_conf=0.5), source=dark_spot_detector filter yields 14 dark-spot cards. Case SPL-20260610-001: case-detail loaded, btn-focus-spill fires and focus-vessel-label text = 'TOP CANDIDATE — not confirmed · NORDIC TRADER (#1, probable)' (case not confirmed — correct). tab-beforeafter reveals before-after-view with before-after-before + before-after-after panes (S1D 2026-06-07 / S1A 2026-06-10, blob previews loading). Dark-spot case SPL-20260904-017: spill-flag-experimental_detector text '⚠ EXPERIMENTAL dark-spot detector'; scene-overlay-control present; map-toggle-scene-overlay toggles img.leaflet-image-layer to VISIBLE; scene-overlay-opacity slider present. Scene Explorer (analyst): density-window-select present, selecting hours=2160 renders density-summary '5 bins · max 121 fixes/bin · 2° grid' plus .leaflet-heatmap-layer canvas; scene-watches panel visible (1 row 'Malacca S1'); analyst correctly has NO scene-watch-name-input. Scene Explorer (supervisor): scene-watch-name-input + btn-create-scene-watch present; creating with default global map bbox surfaces server error tooltip 'bbox must be [west, south, east, north] and under ~30°×30°' (correct behaviour — user must zoom to sub-30° region); after zooming to a valid region the create succeeded (row count went from 1 to 6 across runs), delete button present. All 3 role logins work.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> option cannot be a child of <span>'. An <option> element is being rendered inside a <span> somewhere (traceback points to Layout header area — likely the header status pill / duty-status widget). Non-blocking (no visible defect) but pollutes the browser console and will become a real DOM/hydration issue in strict mode.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/imagery.py: sensible query validation (hours 1..8760, zoom 0..14). 60s in-memory density cache keyed by (hours,zoom,bbox) is fine for single-node; note it will not share across gunicorn workers if the deploy ever scales horizontally. Mongo aggregation projects into fixed lat/lon grid — no raw pings leak client-side.

routers/scene_watch.py: proper bbox validation (west<east, south<north, area<=900 sq deg — matches ~30°×30°), collection whitelisted via scene_watch.collection_ok, RBAC correct (supervisor for write, any user for list, cron uses hmac.compare_digest against Bearer secret with idempotency via db.cron_runs on X-Webhook-Id). Consider adding TTL index on db.cron_runs to prevent unbounded growth.

routers/imagery.py detect-dark-spots: wrapped in try/except -> 502. Good. Response payload lists case summaries only (case_id, case_number, confidence, elongation…) — callers must GET /cases/{id} to read source/quality_flags. That is what tests do; consider documenting this in the API note.

BeforeAfter.jsx: panes render even when s is null with a 'no scene found in window' fallback. Blob URL fetch uses timeout — good. Map sync uses a shared closure — clean, but the `link()` handler is registered every time register() runs; second registration re-adds move handlers on the earlier map. Not user-visible but a small leak on remount.

SceneWatches.jsx (supervisor create): submits current map bbox; if the user hasn't zoomed in, backend rightly rejects with 400. UX would be improved by disabling btn-create-scene-watch (or showing a hint) when current map bbox area > 30°×30° instead of relying on server 400 -> toast.
React console: '<span> option cannot be a child of <span>' hydration warning fires on every route change. Should be tracked down and fixed.

Note: /app/backend/pytest.ini enables xdist by default (-n auto), so use -o addopts='' when running a single file to disable it (otherwise KeyError on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL loading gets duplicated collection errors).
